brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: Three bases at 0,0 0,1 1,0 form compact cluster; notch drawer frame hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf placed at 1,1 k=2 (notch:0#1,1#notch2) between 0,1 and 1,0 provides drawer.

requirements.requirement: Spike at corner where three bases meet holding small platform
requirements.evidence: Mount spike spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0 at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 where three bases meet, fitted with accessory platform-sm

finish.summary: Built compact 3-base triangle with notch drawer at 1,1 and mount spike with small platform at center junction. Connectors lock bases; check_build ok true meshClash clear.

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
